'''Hattori Gatano''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]]. 

==History==
Her Warder is [[Sleete]], whom she bonded ten years before the Last Battle.

==Strength and Abilities ==
Sleete mentioned that Hattori doesn't have much influence in the Tower, suggesting that she may be relatively weak in the One Power.{{ref/book|12|13}}

Since [[Covarla Baldene]] obtained command in [[Dorlan]] because she was the strongest in that group of Aes Sedai, Hattori must have an One Power strength level of {{opsl|28}} or less. She would not be able to [[Travel]] without linking.

==Activities==

She sided with [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]] and [[Hall of the Tower under Elaida a'Roihan|the Hall that followed her]] during the [[White Tower Schism]].

After the schism, she disliked the atmosphere in the White Tower and sought an excuse to leave. She joined Elaida's force set against [[Rand al'Thor]], not knowing the depth of Elaida's order for him. 

At the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]]{{ref/book|6|55}}, she was separated from Sleete, and she returned to the Tower along with ten other sisters led by [[Covarla]]{{ref/book|7|32}}. They were joined by [[Katerine Alruddin]] and [[Tarna Feir]] later.

Elaida secretly sends them to the small village of [[Dorlan]] to hide the disaster of Dumai's Wells to the Hall. So they travel to [[Dorlan]], keeping an eye on the [[Younglings]]{{ref/book|7|32}}.

There, she reunited with Sleete, who was wounded during the battle and stayed away for a while to recover{{ref/book|12|13}}.

Elaida ordered to the sisters in Dorlan and the Younglings to start a guerilla campaign against the rebel sisters army during the [[siege of Tar Valon]]{{ref/book|10|p}}{{ref/book|12|4}}.

[[Gawyn Trakand]] thinks that she has eyes on him for her next Warder, but he still wanted to be with Egwene.{{ref/book|13|5}}
